# Load

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(GEOquery)
library(janitor)
```


-----

# GEO Download

## Get metadata

```{r}
# https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE223817
if (file.exists(here("data/GSE223817_geo_object.rds"))) {
  message("Loading data from disk")
  geo_data <- readRDS(here("data/GSE223817_geo_object.rds"))
} else {
  message("Downloading GEO data")
  geo_data <- getGEO(GEO="GSE223817", GSEMatrix=TRUE)
  saveRDS(geo_data, here("data/GSE223817_geo_object.rds"))
}
```

```{r}
geo_data
```

```{r}
geo_pdata <- pData(geo_data$GSE223817_series_matrix.txt.gz)
```

-----

## Get beta matrix

```{r}
getGEOSuppFiles("GSE223817", fetch_files = FALSE)
```

```{r}
if (file.exists(here("data/GSE223817_Endo_Normalised_Beta_Values.txt.gz"))) {
  message("File already exists")
} else {
  message("Downloading GEO data")
  getGEOSuppFiles("GSE223817", makeDirectory=FALSE, baseDir=here("data"), 
                  filter_regex="GSE223817_Endo_Normalised_Beta_Values")
}
```


```{r}
geo_beta <- read_table(here("data/GSE223817_Endo_Normalised_Beta_Values.txt.gz"), 
                       skip=1, col_names=c("probe_id", geo_pdata$geo_accession))
```

```{r}
head(geo_beta, 5:6)
```

```{r}
dim(geo_beta)
```

-----

## Get M matrix

```{r}
if (file.exists(here("data/GSE223817_Endo_Normalised_M_Values.txt.gz"))) {
  message("File already exists")
} else {
  message("Downloading GEO data")
  getGEOSuppFiles("GSE223817", makeDirectory=FALSE, baseDir=here("data"), 
                  filter_regex="GSE223817_Endo_Normalised_M_Values")
}
```

```{r}
geo_m <- read_table(here("data/GSE223817_Endo_Normalised_M_Values.txt.gz"), 
                       skip=1, col_names=c("probe_id", geo_pdata$geo_accession))
```

```{r}
head(geo_m, 5:6)
```

```{r}
dim(geo_m)
```


-----

# Tidy beta matrix

```{r}
geo_beta_matrix <- as.matrix(geo_beta[,-1])
rownames(geo_beta_matrix) <- geo_beta$probe_id
head(geo_beta_matrix, 5:6)
```

-----

# Tidy M matrix

```{r}
geo_m_matrix <- as.matrix(geo_m[,-1])
rownames(geo_m_matrix) <- geo_beta$probe_id
head(geo_m_matrix, 5:6)
```

-----

# PCA

Check if normalisation was done in the downloaded M values for technical factors like batch or institute.

```{r}
geo_pdata_tidy <- geo_pdata %>% select(geo_accession, ends_with(":ch1"))
colnames(geo_pdata_tidy) <- str_remove(colnames(geo_pdata_tidy), ":ch1$")
geo_pdata_tidy <- geo_pdata_tidy %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(complete_barcode=paste(sentrix_id, terminus, sep="_"))
```

```{r}
pca <- prcomp(t(geo_m_matrix[1:100000,]))$x[,1:5]
dat <- cbind(pca, geo_pdata_tidy)
head(dat)
```

```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=recruiment)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=batch)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=cycle_phase)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
table(dat$recruiment, dat$batch)
table(dat$recruiment, dat$plate)
```

Data has large batch effects from recruitment site.

-----

# Save data

```{r}
saveRDS(geo_beta_matrix, file=here("data/GSE223817_beta.rds"))
saveRDS(geo_m_matrix, file=here("data/GSE223817_m.rds"))
saveRDS(geo_pdata, file=here("data/GSE223817_pdata.rds"))
```
